catalog.structure: A 23-page letter PDF with a real text layer (web build, Distiller 5.0.5, Nov 2002). PDF p1 cover and front index, p2 general information (example table skipped), p3 paint and oil, then diagram/table pairs: even page = diagram, odd page = table (pp5-19 decks and drives, p21 gear boxes, p23 decals). The front index counts the diagram page of each pair, so the table pages are the odd pages printed in the index. No page footers. Undated; no part-number prefix other than C and hardware codes.

validation.method: Born-digital PDF with a real text layer: parsed with pdftotext -layout, then the table pages compared by eye with the 100-dpi page renders and the part numbers re-checked against the render; descriptions kept as printed except title headings and the "G200CII" typo (user decision).
validation.quantities: All printed quantities transcribed as printed. No UAR rows. One row (52RD ref 68, C37734) prints no quantity: stored empty with qtyNum null and flagged.
validation.numericalIndex: Not applicable: the book has no numerical index. The front index lists section titles and page numbers only, so there is no index cross-check and there are no index-vs-table differences.
